# Remove Palindromic Subsequences.

@example abaaba is the same reversed, so a single move marks and erases all of it.
"abaaba"
=> 1

@example aabab reversed is babaa, so one move can't take everything; erasing aaa and then bb takes two.
"aabab"
=> 2

@example The five b's are not side by side, but marking them all is one move; the a left over is the second.
"bbbbab"
=> 2

# A single letter is a palindrome.
"a"
=> 1

# Two letters, equal and different.
"bb"
=> 1

"ab"
=> 2

# Alternating letters: many runs of equal letters, still at most two moves.
"ababababab"
=> 2

"bababab"
=> 1

# The only mismatched pair is the innermost one, at even and odd length.
"baaabaab"
=> 2

"abaabba"
=> 2

# The only mismatched pair is the first letter with the last.
"ababbabb"
=> 2

# A single b among a's: in the middle, and one place off the middle.
"aaaabaaaa"
=> 1

"aaaaabaaa"
=> 2

# Longest strings: one letter throughout, and the same with the last
# letter changed.
""
=> 1

""
=> 2

# Random small cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them).
@gen 1 small
"bbb"
=> 1

@gen 3 small
"aaabaa"
=> 2

@gen 8 small
"bba"
=> 2

@gen 9 small
"babbbaaa"
=> 2

@gen 13 small
"ababba"
=> 2

@gen 16 small
"aabaa"
=> 1

@gen 17 small
"bbaba"
=> 2

@gen 22 small
"bbbbabbbb"
=> 1

# Full size: a palindrome of 999 letters, and 1000 letters whose only
# mismatched pair is the innermost one.
@gen 1
""
=> 1

@gen 3
""
=> 2
